list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, cross-checked between Exophase / PSNProfiles via Planet GTA 6 and Output Lag.
notes: Guides are written in our own words for this entry. Counts are stated only where the official description gives a number or at least two sources agree. Trophies marked unconfirmed have no confirmed trigger at launch: only the official description hints at them. The one possibly missable trophy is flagged as reported, not fully confirmed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done — there is no separate task to do. Treat A Long Road as the real final step, since 100% completion is the longest grind in the list, and keep the roadmap below in order so nothing is left for a second playthrough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing early in Chapter 1. It is pure story and cannot be missed — just play the story and it pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story only and unmissable — it unlocks when the chapter ends. Before the chapter closes, do Lucia's balcony meditation for the one trophy that might be missable (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story only and unmissable. Most of the open-world list opens up once both Jason and Lucia are playable in this chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only and unmissable. Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment it appears in this chapter — it is time-sensitive and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only and unmissable. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vaults — take it when it appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so you cannot go back and redo it. After the credits, free roam stays open and the 100% checklist appears.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story only and unmissable. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission, which is what makes the partner trophies possible.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. Story only and unmissable — play the chapter and it pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Story only and unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story — work done earlier still counts. It is the longest trophy in the list: the checklist asks for more than the matching trophies, including 300 stunts instead of 250, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles and 15 of 18 card sets. Save it for last and let the other trophies feed it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, so mix them up as you travel. Keep going to 300 afterwards, since 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Sample one of everything — races, fishing, an arcade game, drone races, the range, meditation and the rest — and it pops once the last type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds across two ranges. Learn what each range scores you on, then clear them one by one; there is no shortcut, just steady accuracy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough — you do not need to win every race at a location, just one at each of them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeat wins on the same race do not count, so spread your wins across race types and locations instead of farming one easy race.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing opens early, so take the challenge on when it appears rather than leaving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Any of the four in-game games counts, so pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, and it stays available after the credits, so there is no rush — work through the strand whenever you play as Lucia.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand stays open after the story ends, so complete it in the post-game cleanup if you have not already.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Billy's strand stays open after the credits — follow it to its end during the side-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass icon.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Randy's strand stays open after the credits — complete it during the side-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and stays open after the story, so play it through as Jason whenever it appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — reported but not fully confirmed: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Do it in Chapter 1 (after Lucia is home, follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house in the morning) and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and 100% completion needs 15 of them, so keep collecting well past three — the cards you find now count toward the endgame too.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan things as you travel and the count builds up on its own — WAiNK scanning also counts toward discovering vehicles, so this pairs naturally with Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, tracked under Progress and then Challenges. Most of them finish on their own while you play, so check the list late in the game and mop up the ones that are close. 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest way is during a bank vault escape — vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away — and it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. Keep the police chasing you the whole time — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of only counting cars you own. 100% completion needs 200 of 277 models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion shooting mode, L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if the group is spread out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport before it pops. Save first, because the police come fast. Reported, not fully confirmed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (a Rhino). Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map — get in, drive and fire until it pops. Save first. Reported, not fully confirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on the store's locked back door, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. 100% completion needs all eight vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone — getting out of the flashing search area is not enough, so keep driving until the heat is fully gone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map. It fills in naturally as you travel for the other trophies, so check the map late in the game and visit any region you have never set foot in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. 100% completion needs all 39 operations, so this pops along the way while you work through them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has confirmed a trigger for this trophy at launch; the official description is the only hint. The natural reading is to order a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach — try a beach bar there and check whether it pops. Do not grind it blind; treat any method as a guess until a source confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has confirmed a trigger for this trophy at launch; the official description is the only hint. It will most likely pop during normal play in a vehicle showroom, so do not chase it specially until a source pins the method down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable. Reported, not fully confirmed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Reported, not fully confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The tracker counts 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind as you play. Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile on purpose: sources report that profile change is permanent. Reported, not fully confirmed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has confirmed a trigger for this trophy at launch; the official description is the only hint. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, so it will most likely pop during normal play. Do not chase it specially until a source confirms the method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has confirmed a trigger for this trophy at launch; the official description is the only hint. The wording points to witnessing something strange in the world, so keep playing and exploring — it will most likely pop on its own. Do not chase it specially until a source confirms the method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has confirmed a trigger for this trophy at launch; the official description is the only hint. The wording points to knocking someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Treat the exact method as unconfirmed until a source pins it down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and the total is cumulative — sell them to your contacts whenever you have them and the count keeps building.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it fills in on its own as you buy weapons, clothes, cars and supplies — check the counter late in the game and top it up with useful purchases.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count, so buy all eight yourself.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
